answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a gale tag. The cedar cap is checked at intake and vault exposes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 17 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
